description: The University of Oklahoma publishes the United States Flood Database, which merges seven flood inventories into a common event table. Version 1.1 includes event dates, coordinates, duration, fatalities, damage, causes, source identifiers and environmental attributes. Coverage begins in 1900, with source snapshots mainly taken in late 2020; the open-ended wording on the landing page does not establish a live feed. Zenodo provides the combined CSV and source CSV or XLSX tables free under CC-BY-4.0. Reporting thresholds and location precision differ between source databases, creating uncertainty in event completeness and matching. The DEPTH attribute is a 500-year flood-model depth, not a measured depth of each historical event. The table can validate simulated event occurrence and support regional flood susceptibility analysis. It complements Dartmouth Flood Observatory, EM-DAT and NOAA reports through harmonisation and source provenance. The files were not downloaded.
